nuggets.text: Marshall Faulk's first head coaching job anywhere is Southern, after one season coaching Colorado's running backs.
Marshall Faulk was the first freshman in NCAA history to lead the nation in both rushing and scoring, at San Diego State.
Marshall Faulk ran for 386 yards in his first start at San Diego State, an NCAA record at the time.
Marshall Faulk, the 2000 NFL MVP, is in four halls of fame, from San Diego State's to the Pro Football Hall of Fame.
Beating Kentucky State 34-15 gave Marshall Faulk his first win as a head coach and Southern its first home win since November 2024.
The Jaguars broke a scoreless tie against Kentucky State with an 85-yard interception return for a touchdown.
Southern's Human Jukebox became the first marching band in the nation with its own license plate in 2017.
Southern's Human Jukebox played Adele's 'Hello' at the 2015 Bayou Classic and drew over a million views in under two weeks.
Southern's Fabulous Dancing Dolls performed with Madonna at the 2012 Super Bowl halftime show.
Three Southern alumni are in the Pro Football Hall of Fame: Mel Blount, Aeneas Williams and Harold Carmichael.
